title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion Runbook

procedure.action: Inspect current database connection pool configuration
Check active connections and identify long-running queries
Simulate increasing the database connection pool capacity
Simulate restarting the affected API service
Monitor database connection utilization and API error rate

verification: API latency should return toward normal levels

procedure.action: Inspect memory utilization and restart history
Identify processes with continuously increasing memory usage
Deploy the simulated memory leak fix

title: CPU Saturation Runbook

procedure.action: Identify the process consuming excessive CPU
Disable the simulated expensive processing path
Monitor CPU utilization and request queue length

verification: Request queue should return toward normal
